3 things to know when running ads for your app:

1/ organic viral ≠ successful ad
organic viral is basically free money, so conversion rate doesn’t matter that much - with ads the content needs to be designed for conversion to be profitable 

2/ let it spend
let every ad get at LEAST $50 of spend before even considering drawing a conclusion on whether it is successful - otherwise you’re guessing on natural variance

3/ variants are king
when you find a winning format, absolutely milk the hell out of it, make tonnes of variants just changing the person in the video, or the hook caption, or the music - this is how agencies run the same format for years
